responsibility: Provides the public x86 CPUID helper header used by user code to query processor capabilities through GCC. It defines the feature-bit macros for many CPUID leaves, vendor signatures, inline asm wrappers for __cpuid and __cpuid_count, and utility functions such as __get_cpuid_max, __get_cpuid, __get_cpuid_count, and __cpuidex, making it the canonical runtime CPU-feature query interface among the i386 target headers.
